subject: ES-MAML kickoff: Hessian-free meta-learning for fast adaptation
body:
Team,

Kicking off the ES-MAML productization. Our open-source ES-MAML release does simple Hessian-free meta-learning via blackbox optimization, and the published follow-up showed rapidly adaptable legged-robot policies - that adaptation speed is what two robotics-adjacent partners are asking us for.

Scope: both algorithm families ship - Zero Order with its custom adaptation operators (blackbox operators like MCBlackboxOptimizer and DPP sampling) and First Order - behind one config surface (everything currently lives in config.py; that becomes a real experiment spec).

Milestones for Mar 16 - May 25: gRPC comms rebuilt and both algorithms running distributed by Apr 10, adaptation benchmark suite by May 8, partner-readiness review by May 22.

Deshawn owns staffing and budget - the meta-learning sweeps are worker-hungry, so fleet sizing is the first conversation.

Dmitri
